mappings.physical_separation_basis: UC Davis Library buildings history and UC Davis Magazine place the old wood-shingle Recreation Hall around 1920–21 with accepted closure in 1938; UC Davis official venue chronology opens the successor Recreation Hall in 1977. Distinct buildings with non-overlapping facility eras, not synonyms for one physical identity.
mappings.resolution_basis: Issue #722 Control Center authorization: old 1921 Recreation Hall separate from the Recreation Hall/University Credit Union Center opened 1977; preserve accepted HOME chronology and original venue key.
